narrative.overview:
The page is a 2000s school binder that the warga have decorated together. The brand-blue fabric cover has a darker spine and a dashed white stitch, a name label stuck on as a sticker, a taped polaroid of real people, and Mochi stuck in the corner. Behind it, every workshop is a loose-leaf sheet with pale-blue rules, a pink margin line and punched holes. Sections start at coloured index tabs. The register is playful and hand-made, but never messy: everything still lines up on the ruled pitch and reads in one pass on a phone.

Craft materials are rendered honestly and flat. Paper, photo, sticker and washi each have their own depth and edge, with no fake bevels or gloss. The page refuses the link-in-bio column of identical rounded cards that it replaced.
keyCharacteristics: Blue binder cover → yellow index tab → loose-leaf sheets, read top to bottom.
Three depth layers: paper < photo < sticker.
Kiss-cut stickers with a 3px white die-cut ring; translucent striped washi.
Real photography only (event photos, real reel posters); no illustration stand-ins.
Motion: stickers "stick" once on load; nothing loops.

rules.name: The Yellow Carries Navy Rule
rules.body: Anything yellow takes Ink Navy text or icons (#10245e on #ffe600), never white.

rules.name: The Honest Colour Rule
rules.body: Status is shown by the sticker colour plus a word (Buka / Segera Dibuka / Segera Hadir) and by paper pattern: ruled for open, grid paper for not yet open. It is never shown by colour alone.

rules.name: The Write-On-The-Lines Rule
rules.body: Text inside a loose-leaf sheet uses a 28px line-height, and the sheet's top padding is 32px, so each baseline sits about 5px above a rule. Rules never strike through text.

rules.name: The Paper < Photo < Sticker Rule
rules.body: A sticker may sit on a photo or a sheet. A sheet never sits on a sticker. Nested "cards" are allowed only when they are distinct world objects in this order.

dos: Do place text on sheets at the 28px pitch with 32px top padding.
Do use Lucide icons at the page stroke weight; put an icon inside a yellow round sticker when it needs presence.
Do keep real data honest: when availability fails, show the last good dates and venue but hide seat counts.
Do keep motion to a single settle on load using cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do give every reel a real poster in images/stories/<shortcode>.webp (480px wide).
donts: Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs (→, 🏘️) as interface icons.
Don't rebuild the uniform rounded-card link-in-bio column this world replaced.
Don't put white text on Sticker Yellow, or use Margin Pink for text.
Don't add looping or bouncy animation, fake urgency, or invented social proof (see seminggu-psych and PRODUCT.md).
